title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The Call Hierarchy stops sweeping the file
summary: The walk added in 1.42.90 to find the enclosing function scanned every symbol back to the top of the file, even when there was nothing above to find.

highlights.title: Two bounds, same answers
highlights.description: A top level function has nothing enclosing it, and once a top level candidate has been weighed there is nothing shallower left. The result is identical, caller for caller.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Opening the Call Hierarchy on a heavily called symbol does less work. The walk out to the enclosing function ran to the top of the file on every reference, which cost 9 percent of that path on a real Android project. The answers are unchanged, caller for caller, across 4014 of them.
